description: Fixture stories with known-good expectations for scripts/evaluate.py. Fictional events and people. Labels were written by hand from the story text; expect_outcome is set only where the right newsroom decision is clear-cut.

stories.title: Arsenal beat Chelsea 2-1 in tense London derby
stories.summary: Arsenal came from behind to beat Chelsea 2-1 at the Emirates. Midfielder Tomas Reyes equalised before half-time and striker Leo Hartmann headed the winner in the 78th minute, lifting Arsenal to second in the Premier League.

stories.title: Liverpool held to goalless draw by Everton
stories.summary: Liverpool were held to a 0-0 draw by Everton at Anfield. Everton goalkeeper Sam Okafor made seven saves as the visitors frustrated the Premier League leaders, who had 24 shots.

stories.title: Tottenham boss sacked after 3-0 defeat at Brentford
stories.summary: Tottenham have sacked head coach Marco Lindqvist after a 3-0 defeat at Brentford left the club 14th in the Premier League. Fans were furious after a sixth defeat in nine games.

stories.title: Newcastle in talks to sign Dortmund winger Felix Amari
stories.summary: Newcastle are in talks with Borussia Dortmund over a January transfer for winger Felix Amari. The 23-year-old has scored six goals this season and Newcastle are weighing a fee of around 40 million euros.

stories.title: Aston Villa captain ruled out for six weeks with hamstring injury
stories.summary: Aston Villa captain Dan Mercer has been ruled out for six weeks with a hamstring injury suffered against Fulham. Villa will be without their captain for the busy December schedule.

stories.title: VAR row as Brighton denied late penalty against West Ham
stories.summary: Brighton were furious after VAR declined to award a late penalty in their 1-1 draw with West Ham. Manager Oscar Feld said the decision was a disgrace.

stories.title: Manchester City thrash Wolves 4-0
stories.summary: Manchester City thrashed Wolves 4-0 at the Etihad. Forward Kai Brandt scored twice and City have now won four Premier League games in a row.

stories.title: Real Madrid stunned 2-0 by Sevilla in La Liga upset
stories.summary: Real Madrid suffered a shock 2-0 defeat away at Sevilla. Striker Ivan Molero scored both goals as Real Madrid dropped to third, two points behind Barcelona.

stories.title: Celtic beat Rangers 3-1 to extend Scottish Premiership lead
stories.summary: Celtic beat Rangers 3-1 at Celtic Park to move five points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership. Winger Ross Callan scored twice in a dominant second-half display.

stories.title: Inter Milan agree contract extension with Paolo Ricci
stories.summary: Inter Milan have agreed a contract extension with centre-back Paolo Ricci until 2030. The 27-year-old has made 140 Serie A appearances.

stories.title: Manchester United lost 2-1 to Fulham at Old Trafford
stories.summary: Manchester United lost 2-1 at home to Fulham on Sunday. Fulham winger Ade Bankole scored the winner in the 88th minute, leaving United 13th in the Premier League.

stories.title: Paris Saint-Germain beaten 1-0 by Marseille
stories.summary: Paris Saint-Germain were beaten 1-0 by Marseille at the Velodrome, their first Ligue 1 defeat in 11 matches. Midfielder Yanis Belkacem scored the only goal.

stories.title: Juventus and Napoli draw 2-2 in Turin
stories.summary: Juventus drew 2-2 with Napoli in Turin. Napoli striker Marco Bellini scored twice in nine minutes before Juventus hit back late.

stories.title: Chelsea appoint Lukas Brandt as head coach
stories.summary: Chelsea have appointed Lukas Brandt as head coach on a three-year contract after the departure of their previous boss.

stories.title: Liverpool striker ruled out for three months with knee injury
stories.summary: Liverpool striker Darwin Ekong will miss three months after knee surgery, a blow to the Premier League leaders before the busy winter schedule.

stories.title: Everton complete loan signing of Wolves forward Jay Rivers
stories.summary: Everton have completed the loan signing of Wolves forward Jay Rivers until the end of the season. The 21-year-old scored 4 goals for Wolves last season.

stories.title: Newcastle thrash Southampton 5-0 at St James' Park
stories.summary: Newcastle thrashed Southampton 5-0 at St James' Park. Striker Callum Weir scored a hat-trick as Newcastle climbed to fourth in the Premier League.

stories.title: Brentford fined after players surround referee
stories.summary: Brentford have been fined after players surrounded the referee during their defeat to Crystal Palace. The club said it would not appeal the decision.

stories.title: Celtic boss Rory Quinn signs new contract
stories.summary: Celtic manager Rory Quinn has signed a new contract until 2029 after leading the club to back-to-back titles.

stories.title: Bayern Munich come from behind to win 3-2 at Bayer Leverkusen
stories.summary: Bayern Munich scored twice in the final ten minutes to win 3-2 at Bayer Leverkusen in the Bundesliga. Substitute Jonas Weber struck the winner in stoppage time to send Bayern top.

stories.title: Aston Villa stun Manchester City with 1-0 win
stories.summary: Aston Villa stunned Manchester City with a 1-0 win at Villa Park. Defender Ollie Grant headed the only goal as City suffered a third straight defeat.

stories.title: England name squad for World Cup qualifiers
stories.summary: England have named their squad for next month's World Cup qualifiers, with three uncapped players included.

stories.title: West Ham held 2-2 by Bournemouth after late equaliser
stories.summary: West Ham were held to a 2-2 draw by Bournemouth at the London Stadium. Bournemouth defender Kofi Asante equalised in the 90th minute.

stories.title: Crystal Palace winger handed three-match ban for red card
stories.summary: Crystal Palace winger Eze Martins has been handed a three-match ban after his red card against Everton. Palace will appeal, calling the decision harsh.

stories.title: Ipswich beat Leicester 2-0 for first win of the season
stories.summary: Ipswich beat Leicester 2-0 to earn their first Premier League win of the season. Goalkeeper Ben Hollis kept a clean sheet.
